      Settings

      Appearance

      Study timer

      Each study step starts its countdown. Tap the countdown to pause or resume. Green means running. After zero it turns red and counts extra time with a +. Paused timers are gray; long press a paused timer to reset and restart. The timer pauses while you visit menu pages.

      Start on your iPhone

      1. Open in Safari → Share → Add to Home Screen. Launch from that icon.
      2. In My materials, import your full book PDF (or the three PDF parts) and your L001-LESSON.mp3 recordings. You can start with lessons 1–3.
      3. Choose your lesson and follow each step. Your place saves automatically.
      4. Wait for “App available offline”, then try reopening in Airplane Mode.

      The prepared pages apply to the supplied book, as one PDF or three parts. Lesson playback includes the spoken title. In Shadowing, each primary cut corresponds to a numbered dialogue item in the book. A warning appears if your active cut count differs from the book. Play continues freely from the playhead; Repeat sentence replays the selected cut. Some cuts are drafts: use Edit sentence below the player to preview and save corrections. Saved edits take priority over updated prepared timings.

      Safari tabs and Home Screen apps may have separate storage. Import inside the app you plan to use.
